title: Lesson 5｜报告类文章（原因-影响-解决）
summary: Report/Problem-Cause-Effect-Solution 风格的 Task 2：中立客观、结构清晰、6.5 级模板与练习。

parts.title: 报告类结构与语气
keypoints: 语气：中立客观、基于现象描述；尽量避免主观强烈态度词
常见结构：引言（改写题干+指出问题）→ 原因（1-2 个）→ 影响（1-2 个）→ 解决方案（1-2 个）→ 结论（简要总结）
段内：主题句→解释→例子/数据化描述（如适用）→小结；连接自然
常用连接：As a result / Consequently（结果）；Therefore（因此）；One possible solution is ...（解决）

parts.title: 6.5 级常用模板与用语
keypoints: 引言：The issue of ... has raised public concern.; This essay reports the possible causes and effects, and suggests solutions.
原因：One major cause is that ...; This is mainly because ...; Another contributing factor is ...
影响：As a result/Consequently, ...; This may lead to ...; It can cause ...
解决：One possible solution is to ...; Authorities/Schools/Companies can ...; It would be helpful to ...

exercises.title: 引言：中立概述 + 结构预告
exercises.instruction: 用客观表达引出问题，并概括将讨论的块（原因/影响/解决）。

items.text: youth unemployment has raised public concern. This essay

items.answer: reports the possible causes and effects

exercises.title: 原因与影响：块内展开
exercises.instruction: 填写原因与影响的连接/模板用语，保持中性、逻辑清晰。

items.text: some graduates lack practical skills required by employers.
the mismatch between regional industries and training programs.
, young people may accept temporary or low-paid jobs,

exercises.title: 解决方案：可行与具体
exercises.instruction: 补全解决方案的表达，让建议具体可行（主体/责任方清晰）。

items.text: build partnerships between universities and companies for internship programs.
provide incentives for firms that offer training to young employees.
, graduates are more likely to gain experience and secure stable positions.

exercises.title: 结论：简洁总结（不引入新观点）
exercises.instruction: 用简短中立语言收束全文，呼应前文块。

items.text: , the rise in youth unemployment can be explained by skill gaps and regional mismatch; practical training and policy incentives may help ease the problem.

tips.title: 报告类引言（中立客观）
tips.content: The issue of ... has raised public concern.; This essay reports the possible causes and effects, and suggests solutions.

tips.title: 原因块（6.5 级）
tips.content: One major cause is that ...; This is mainly because ...; Another contributing factor is ...（避免过激词）

tips.title: 影响块（清晰结果）
tips.content: As a result/Consequently, ...; This may lead to ...; It can cause ...（注意因果清晰，不要跳步）

tips.title: 解决块（可行建议）
tips.content: One possible solution is to ...; Authorities/Schools/Companies can ...; Therefore/Thus ...（说明预期效果）

tips.title: 结论（不引入新信息）
tips.content: In conclusion/To sum up, ...；回扣原因/影响/解决，不新增论点或数据。
